entities.summary: Lucien Wolf was an English Jewish journalist, diplomat, historian, and advocate of rights for Jews and other minorities. While Wolf was devoted to minority rights, he opposed Jewish nationalism as expressed in Zionism, which he regarded as an incentive to anti-Semitism. In 1917 he co-founded the anti-Zionist League of British Jews.
